faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Part Time Lecturer position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Part Time Lecturer position at Government Polytechnic Marwahi is 30 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for Part Time Lecturer?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Part Time Lecturer post in Government Polytechnic Marwahi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Part Time Lecturer post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have a B.E./B.Tech with First Class in a relevant Engineering/Technology branch or an M.E./M.Tech with First Class at either the Bachelor or Master level, as per AICTE norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Part Time Lecturer position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Part Time Lecturer is Rs. 800 per period, with a maximum monthly earning of Rs. 56100.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Part Time Lecturer recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Merit List based on marks in BE, ME, experience, and interview, followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. When is the interview date for the Part Time Lecturer position?
faq.answer: The interview date for the Part Time Lecturer position is scheduled for 07 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article, under the "Official Notification PDF" link.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of Government Polytechnic Marwahi?
faq.answer: The official website of Government Polytechnic Marwahi is http://gppmarwahi.gptubh.io/gprmarwahi/.
